summary: Full-site regression on the expanded SB Creatives site. Backend contact API + all frontend routes/pages, work filters, service links, case study nav, insights, about, legal, and complete contact form flow (empty→toast, no-consent→toast, success→persist) all pass. Only issue: SVG animation console warnings ('undefined' width/r/x1) on illustrated service/hero cards, likely a framer-motion animation initial state issue.

issues: Console emits repeated SVG warnings: '<rect> attribute width: Expected length, undefined' and '<circle> attribute r: undefined' / '<line> attribute x1: undefined' during animation start. Cosmetic (no crash) but pollutes console. Likely an SVG component using motion values that are undefined on first render — set initial numeric values or guard with default values.

action_items: Investigate & fix SVG animation initial-state warnings (undefined width/r/x1) in the animated illustration components used on Home and Services pages. Ensure numeric defaults for animated attributes to eliminate the console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER it is referenced inside create_contact() and imported at module scope. Currently works because create_contact runs at request time (after logging.basicConfig executes), but it's fragile — move the logger/basicConfig block above the routes.
Contact form: consent is a soft check on the client (server accepts consent=False). If business rule is 'must consent', enforce on server too (raise 400 when consent is False).
GET /api/contact is unauthenticated — anyone can dump all enquiries. Add auth or remove from public surface.
seed_data_creation: test_sbc_api.py inserts TEST_-prefixed contact entries into db.contacts (a few rows). Safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 routes (/,/services,/services/:slug x5,/work,/work/:slug,/insights,/insights/:slug,/about,/contact,/privacy-policy,/terms) return 200. All nav testids present. Work has 5 filters + 10 project cards. 5 service-link testids on /services. Contact form validates empty fields, validates consent, and submits successfully persisting to /api/contact. Only non-functional issue is the SVG 'undefined' animation warning on animated illustration cards.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. SVG warnings are from animated SVG shapes whose attributes (width/r/x1/x2) are undefined on the first render tick before framer-motion initialises them. Provide numeric initial values (initial={{ width: 0, r: 0, ... }}) or use CSS transforms instead of animating raw SVG length attributes.
